messages:
sre-ops: Heads up — getting a surge of SSO failures for Acme Payments after their IdP cert rollover about 10:30 UTC. ~20% of auth flows 403-ing on ACS redirect. stack traces show 'RecipientMismatch' in SAML validate.
support-ingest: Thanks, can you paste the exact error log and the ACS URL the customer is sending? any RelayState included?
sre-ops: Error snippet from our auth-service logs: `ERROR saml: assertion recipient mismatch: expected=https://redwood.example.com/sso/acs got=https://acme-pay.example.com/sso/acs` — they use an alias host. RelayState present. Repro: run against prod: `/auth/sso?provider=acme&relaystate=xyz` -> 403.
customer-jane: Confirmed — after IdP rotated certs we immediately hit the 403s. Some users can login intermittently.
eng-plat: Two quick hypotheses: 1) IdP metadata now publishes a different EntityID (maybe with trailing slash or host variant) so our SP-Entity mapping doesn't match, 2) SigningKey order changed and our metadata cache picked up only the old key until refresh. Can you fetch their metadata URL and paste it?
sre-ops: Pulled metadata: `https://idp.acme-pay.com/metadata.xml` — entityID is `https://idp.acme-pay.com/` (trailing slash). Our stored mapping expects `https://idp.acme-pay.com` (no slash). Also KeyDescriptor list: first is new signing key (sha256=abc...), second is old (sha1=...).
devex: Classic. Our SAML library canonicalizes entityIDs strictly. Trailing slash mismatch will cause perceived recipient/audience mismatch depending on how the IdP signs the assertion. Also if the IdP rotated signing keys and the signature used the new key, our cached metadata might've validated against the old key.
support-ingest: What is the cache TTL for external IdP metadata? Could explain intermittent logins while cache rotates.
eng-plat: Metadata cache TTL is 10m in prod, but we have a staggered poller. Looks like poller errored once at 10:32 and retried slowly -> stale keys persisted for ~8 minutes. Meanwhile their IdP started serving new certs.
deploy-bot: [deploy] triggered metadata-poller refresh for idp.acme-pay.com at 10:45 UTC
sre-ops: After forcing a refresh, our logs show `metadata validated new key: sha256=abc...` but the RecipientMismatch persists for some hosts. Checking ACS host alias config now.
devex: Are you normalizing ACS hostnames? If user flows use acme-pay subdomain, our assertion consumer URL must be listed as an allowed alias or we need to accept host alias in SP config. Check the SP metadata — did we list `https://redwood.example.com/sso/acs` only or include `https://acme-pay.example.com/sso/acs`?
sre-ops: SP metadata only had `https://redwood.example.com/sso/acs`. We historically used host-based routing for customers, but this alias was newly introduced by their infra team.
customer-jane: They rolled out a vanity domain for branding yesterday. IdP metadata update included new AssertionConsumerService entries pointing at that alias.
eng-plat: Two remediations: a) Add alias ACS entries to SP config for that customer (accept both hosts), b) If we prefer single ACS, ask IdP to use the canonical SP ACS and add a rewrite at their edge. Also ensure metadata cache poller retries are robust.
sre-ops: Quick workaround I applied: added `https://acme-pay.example.com/sso/acs` to SP allowed recipients for that tenant. I also ran a manual metadata validation: ```curl -s https://idp.acme-pay.com/metadata.xml | xmllint --xpath 'string(//EntityDescriptor/@entityID)' -``` gave `https://idp.acme-pay.com/`.
support-ingest: Customer reported logins mostly recovered after your alias change. Any follow-ups to prevent recurrence?
eng-plat: Action items: 1) make metadata poller log and alert on transient failures (ticket #INFRA-982), 2) update SP onboarding checklist to record all ACS host aliases, 3) tolerate entityID trailing slash normalization during validation (PR queued), 4) add a manual metadata refresh button in console for enterprise tenants (product).
devex: Note: we should also surface helpful error in the auth debug page: 'Recipient mismatch — consider adding ACS host alias or updating IdP to canonical ACS'. Short repro steps and suggested fixes would reduce support tickets.
customer-jane: Thanks team, appreciate fast turnaround. Please keep me posted on long-term fix timeline.
eng-plat: I'll open INFRA-982 and a follow-up in PROD-RUNNERS to harden poller; ETA for normalization PR is EOD tomorrow.
sre-ops: Closing loop here — forcing a metadata refresh + adding ACS alias cleared ~95% of errors. Leaving thread to docs/ops to track the rest. :white_check_mark:
